full_judgment: that while he was on a patrol duty be attended a Jatra performance and assaulted a student of a school and wrongfully confined him in the house of on Nazirul Islam of village Abiabad. A complaint was filed against him and an enquiry was held by the Sub divisional Police Officer Kishoregonj. He, after enquiry, found the plaintiff guilty of misconduct and submitted his report to the Superintendent of Police, Mymensingh who on consideration of the said report dismissed the plaintiff as per his order dated 30.6.61. It was the case of the plaintiff that the enquiry was not held in accordance with law and no second show cause notice was served upon him as to the proposed punishment. The plaintiff filed a departmental appeal but that was dismissed. Thereafter the plaintiff filed this suit for declaration that the order of dismissal dated 30.6.61 is illegal, inoperative and without any legal authority. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing a written statement stating that all the formalities were observed before dismissing the plaintiff. It was further contended that the suit was not maintainable as it was barred by limitation. The learned Subordinate Judge on consideration of materials on record decreed the suit holding that the suit was not barred by limitation and declared that the order of dismissal is void, illegal, ultra vires and is of no legal effect. As against that judgment and decree the Respondent No. 1 preferred an appeal which was allowed by the learned Additional District Judge, 4th Court Dacca. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree the plaintiff filed this appeal.
